consequence.statement: No operator-facing effect is described; the item is a dependency and toolchain update of Flux itself (built against Kubernetes v1.34.0 libraries and Go 1.25.0).

assertion.statement: Flux 2.7.0 updates its build to Kubernetes v1.34.0 libraries and Go 1.25.0, and the release note describes no operator-facing effect of this dependency/toolchain update.

proposal.undeterminedReason: change: The evidence states only the versions Flux is updated to (Kubernetes v1.34.0, Go 1.25.0); the previously pinned versions and any semantic change are not stated, so no before/after version change or other change type can be asserted.; applicability: The evidence describes a build-level update to Flux itself (the Kubernetes libraries and Go toolchain it is built with) and states no environment condition under which any effect would reach a customer environment.
